title: Expand your most profitable service: Printing
finding: Printing generates RM6900.00 in revenue with an estimated profit margin of 72.3% (profit: RM4991.64).
recommendation: Invest more marketing effort into printing services. Look for ways to scale this offering -- new customers, higher pricing, or complementary add-ons.
rationale: Your most profitable category is where you get the best return for your effort. Doubling down on it is usually more effective than trying to fix a weaker category.
